summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Alamos Gold Inc., a foreign private issuer, providing an operational update on its Canadian mining operations. The filing discloses that Young-Davidson experienced two seismic events and power outages, impacting production and mining rates. The company revised its Q2 2026 production guidance to 130,000-135,000 ounces, a 12% decrease from prior mid-point guidance, and expects full-year production below the low end of prior guidance. No financial terms, board recommendations, deal mechanics, or strategic corporate actions are discussed. This routine operational update does not constitute a special situation.
